recipes.name: The Easiest Nutella Milkshake (3 Ingredients)
ingredients: ¼ cup (70g) Nutella, plus more for garnish
2 pretzel rods - 1 in the milkshake, 1 for garnish
instructions: In a blender, combine the ice cream, one pretzel rod, and your Nutella and blend. Start on low until it begins to come together and then increase the speed to high until combined.
Pour the milkshake into a glass. Dip your other pretzel rod into your container of Nutella and place it, Nutella side down, into the milkshake for a nice surprise. Serve and enjoy.
